name: salesforce-account-engagement
notes: MCP_HTTP_AUTH_MODE=bearer (or proxy) is required; the server fails closed without it.
Authorization header authenticates the MCP client — it is NOT a Salesforce token.
Do not put Salesforce client secrets or refresh tokens in ChatGPT connector headers.
Authenticate the MCP host to Salesforce using server-side refresh tokens / auth login.
Keep AE_READ_ONLY=true unless write access is explicitly required.
